President Donald Trump met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in China on Thursday, but the encounter got off to something of an odd start.

As Trump walked through the door, he immediately pointed across the room at Putin.

“Who is he?” Trump asked, then chuckled and added: “He’s my friend!”

Trump walked over to Putin and the two shook hands.

“Nice to see you,” he said to Putin, then repeated it. “Nice to see you.”

Trump leaned in and said something into Putin’s ear, but it was not picked up by the mic.

Most Western leaders have avoided meeting with Putin since he launched his war on Ukraine in February 2022. During the 2024 campaign, Trump vowed to end the war if elected, and repeatedly said he would do so on his first day as president or even before taking office.

“I would fix that within 24 hours, and if I win, before I get into the office, I will have that war settled,” he told Sean Hannity in 2023. “100% sure.”

The war continues.

Last month, Trump announced a deal with Russia to obtain diesel fuel as prices reached historic highs due in large part to his war on Iran.
